text.p: -- Merrill Lynch analyst Margaret Alexandre on Friday raised her rating for SunAmerica Inc to intermediate buy from accumulate.
-- Alexandre kept SunAmerica as a long-term buy.
-- "SunAmerica has shown an ability to maneuver well in a variety of interest-rate environments," she told Reuters.
-- "... This company has been a leader in almost every front over the last five years. The recent selloff suggests it was oversold and this could be a good entry point."
-- Alexandre raised her estimate for fiscal 1998 earnings per share to $3.15 from $3 because of SunAmerica's purchase of John Alden Financial Corp's annuity operations.
-- Her estimate of $2.65 fiscal 1997 earnings per share was unchanged.
-- Shares in the Los Angeles financial services company closed on Thursday at 44-3/8.
